kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتمل (form VIII)
# نَعْتَمِلُ (naʕtamilu) /naʕ.ta.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# نَعْتَمِلَ (naʕtamila) /naʕ.ta.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# نَعْتَمِلْ (naʕtamil) /naʕ.ta.mil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
